tasks.title: Multi-Channel UTM Sheet
tasks.submission: A structured JSON or CSV of URLs.
tasks.assignment: Build a structured UTM parameter sheet for a multi-channel campaign across Email, LinkedIn, and Google Ads.
tasks.ai_review: The AI verifies that utm_source, utm_medium, and utm_campaign are correctly formatted with no spaces or broken characters.

tasks.title: CRM Lead Scoring Matrix
tasks.submission: A logical flowchart or text matrix.
tasks.assignment: Design a CRM lead scoring matrix.
tasks.ai_review: The AI checks whether the student correctly applied weights to behavioral triggers such as +10 points for downloading a whitepaper and -5 points for unsubscribing.

tasks.title: 3-Step Email Drip
tasks.assignment: Write a 3-step automated email drip campaign.
tasks.ai_review: The AI uses NLP to evaluate the copy for spam-trigger words, checks CTA clarity, and ensures personalized merge tags like {{First_Name}} are used correctly.

tasks.title: Lead Ad to Google Sheet Automation
tasks.assignment: Connect a Facebook Lead Ad to a Google Sheet using Make.com or Zapier.
tasks.ai_review: The AI fires a test payload to the student's webhook to see if it successfully catches the data and returns a 200 OK status.

tasks.title: Full Funnel Automation Blueprint
tasks.submission: Funnel logic document, wireframe, and tracking setup.
tasks.assignment: Map out a complete funnel from ad click to CRM conversion, including the automation logic, landing page wireframe, and tracking pixels.
tasks.ai_review: The AI evaluates the funnel logic, ensuring there are no dead ends in the customer journey and that GDPR or DPDP consent checkboxes are included in the data collection strategy.
